text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That time went straight into prep and follow-ups.

**2. CRM quality improved.** Notes were more complete and more consistent, which made pipeline reviews far less guesswork.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront and explaining how data is handled turned most hesitation into agreement.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Managers still had to coach on reading the room.

**5. Adoption followed example.** Usage climbed once team leads shared their own notes in meetings.

Our takeaway: AI handles the record-keeping, and people still own the relationship.

What has your team learned from piloting AI tools?
